Players Committee card image of [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V) (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “'''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may exchange an Interrupt from hand with bottom card of your Reserve Deck. Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/hothiceplains_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3515e91b0f5636658fca65b3ec5bc7d79d105a8f 3515e91] (30 August 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
